scope: The separately authorized production migration. Interpreter and C API removal milestones remain closed.
implementation: Full-timeline fallback actors publish all 25 TweenPose targets through the existing timing, ordered message and per-frame buffers. Startup native tween queues keep their separate SongTweenReplay path.
The full overlay drain supports 66 targets: 25 pose, 31 immediate and 10 scheduled renderer properties. Existing narrower drains remain consuming projections of the same buffer.
Sampled XYZ/aux update current getters; other supported pose samples update destination getters and operands used by later relative setters. Player-root transform exclusions follow the native setter.
Later-actor reads use previous-frame XYZ. Direct XYZ writes update that prior-position entry when present.
Stop discards position destinations and preserves the frozen current position. Finish merges pending and newer frame destinations, applies native getter rules and emits owned final output.
Successful queued and recurring callbacks reconcile fallback current XYZ at the existing native boundaries without holding metadata locks over host operations.

corrected_failures.cause: An invalid 1.e-7 literal was parsed as a field expression. Corrected to 1.0e-7 before tests could run.

The strict assertion now requires X=16, destination X=16 and the following addx(1) destination X=17. Rust destination state was aligned accordingly; coverage retained.
Three new lazy-evaluation/question-mark suggestions were corrected. Final diagnostics match the existing 166 warnings and cmd.rs:349 error.
